file.content:
main:
  params: [args]
  steps:
    - debug_args:
        call: sys.log
        args:
          text: '${"Received args: " + json.encode_to_string(args)}'
          severity: INFO

    - init:
        assign:
          - project_id: ${args.project_id}
          - environment: ${args.environment}
          - vms: ${args.vms}
          - bucket: ${args.bucket}
          - network: ${args.network}
          - subnet: ${args.subnet}
          - validator_url: ${args.validator_url}
          - date_suffix: ${text.substring(time.format(sys.now()), 0, 10)}
          - results: []

    - get_slack_webhook:
        call: googleapis.secretmanager.v1.projects.secrets.versions.accessString
        args:
          project_id: ${project_id}
          secret_id: "restore-test-slack-webhook"
          version: "latest"
        result: slack_webhook_url

    - fetch_all_snapshots:
        call: googleapis.compute.v1.snapshots.list
        args:
          project: ${project_id}
          maxResults: 500
        result: all_snapshots_response

    - store_snapshots:
        assign:
          - all_snapshots: ${default(all_snapshots_response.items, [])}

    - iterate_vms:
        for:
          value: vm
          in: ${vms}
          steps:
            - init_vm_vars:
                assign:
                  - restored_disks: []
                  - disks_to_create: []

            - process_vm:
                try:
                  steps:
                    - log_start:
                        call: sys.log
                        args:
                          text: '${"Starting restore test for VM " + vm.name + " in project " + project_id}'
                          severity: INFO

                    - record_start_time:
                        assign:
                          - start_time: ${sys.now()}

                    # Get original VM to discover all disks dynamically
                    - get_original_vm:
                        call: googleapis.compute.v1.instances.get
                        args:
                          project: ${project_id}
                          zone: ${vm.zone}
                          instance: ${vm.name}
                        result: original_vm

                    - log_disks_found:
                        call: sys.log
                        args:
                          text: '${"Found " + string(len(original_vm.disks)) + " disks for VM " + vm.name}'
                          severity: INFO

                    # Initialize variables
                    - init_disk_vars:
                        assign:
                          - all_snapshots_used: []
                          - missing_snapshots: []

                    # PHASE 1: Prepare disk info (find snapshots for each disk)
                    - prepare_disks:
                        for:
                          value: disk
                          in: ${original_vm.disks}
                          steps:
                            - extract_disk_name:
                                assign:
                                  - disk_name: ${text.split(disk.source, "/")[len(text.split(disk.source, "/")) - 1]}
                                  - is_boot: ${disk.boot}

                            - log_processing_disk:
                                call: sys.log
                                args:
                                  text: '${"Preparing disk: " + disk_name + " (boot=" + string(is_boot) + ")"}'
                                  severity: INFO

                            # Find matching snapshots for this disk
                            - init_matching:
                                assign:
                                  - matching_snapshots: []

                            - find_disk_snapshots:
                                for:
                                  value: snapshot
                                  in: ${all_snapshots}
                                  steps:
                                    - check_snapshot_match:
                                        switch:
                                          - condition: ${text.match_regex(snapshot.sourceDisk, ".*/" + disk_name + "$") and snapshot.status == "READY"}
                                            assign:
                                              - matching_snapshots: ${list.concat(matching_snapshots, snapshot)}

                            # Check if we found snapshots
                            - check_has_snapshots:
                                switch:
                                  - condition: ${len(matching_snapshots) == 0}
                                    steps:
                                      - log_no_snapshot:
                                          call: sys.log
                                          args:
                                            text: '${"WARNING: No snapshot found for disk " + disk_name}'
                                            severity: WARNING
                                      - record_missing:
                                          assign:
                                            - missing_snapshots: ${list.concat(missing_snapshots, disk_name)}
                                      - skip_disk:
                                          next: continue

                            # Find latest snapshot for this disk
                            - find_latest:
                                assign:
                                  - latest_snapshot: ${matching_snapshots[0]}
                                  - latest_time: ${time.parse(matching_snapshots[0].creationTimestamp)}

                            - compare_disk_snapshots:
                                for:
                                  value: snap
                                  in: ${matching_snapshots}
                                  steps:
                                    - get_snap_time:
                                        assign:
                                          - snap_time: ${time.parse(snap.creationTimestamp)}
                                    - compare_snap_times:
                                        switch:
                                          - condition: ${int(snap_time) > int(latest_time)}
                                            assign:
                                              - latest_snapshot: ${snap}
                                              - latest_time: ${snap_time}

                            # Record snapshot used
                            - record_snapshot_used:
                                assign:
                                  - all_snapshots_used: ${list.concat(all_snapshots_used, latest_snapshot.name)}

                            # Add to disks_to_create list for parallel creation
                            - add_disk_to_create:
                                assign:
                                  - restored_disk_name: ${"restore-test-" + vm.name + "-" + disk_name + "-" + date_suffix}
                                  - disk_info:
                                      disk_name: ${disk_name}
                                      restored_name: ${restored_disk_name}
                                      snapshot_link: ${latest_snapshot.selfLink}
                                      is_boot: ${is_boot}
                                      device_name: ${disk.deviceName}
                                  - disks_to_create: ${list.concat(disks_to_create, disk_info)}

                    # Check if we have at least one disk to create (including boot)
                    - check_disks_to_create:
                        switch:
                          - condition: ${len(disks_to_create) == 0}
                            steps:
                              - no_disks:
                                  assign:
                                    - test_result:
                                        vm_name: ${vm.name}
                                        result: "FAIL"
                                        failure_reason: "No disk snapshots found"
                              - append_no_disks:
                                  assign:
                                    - results: ${list.concat(results, test_result)}
                              - notify_no_disks:
                                  call: notify_slack
                                  args:
                                    webhook_url: ${slack_webhook_url}
                                    vm_name: ${vm.name}
                                    project_id: ${project_id}
                                    environment: ${environment}
                                    app_type: ${vm.app_type}
                                    result: "FAIL"
                                    failure_reason: "No disk snapshots found"
                                    duration_seconds: 0
                                    snapshot_name: "N/A"
                                    evidence_url: "N/A"
                                    disks_count: 0
                              - skip_vm:
                                  next: continue

                    - log_creating_disks:
                        call: sys.log
                        args:
                          text: '${"Creating " + string(len(disks_to_create)) + " disks in parallel for VM " + vm.name}'
                          severity: INFO

                    # PHASE 2: Create all disks in PARALLEL
                    - create_disks_parallel:
                        parallel:
                          shared: [restored_disks]
                          for:
                            value: disk_info
                            in: ${disks_to_create}
                            steps:
                              - log_creating_disk:
                                  call: sys.log
                                  args:
                                    text: '${"Creating disk " + disk_info.restored_name}'
                                    severity: INFO

                              - create_disk:
                                  call: googleapis.compute.v1.disks.insert
                                  args:
                                    project: ${project_id}
                                    zone: ${vm.zone}
                                    body:
                                      name: ${disk_info.restored_name}
                                      sourceSnapshot: ${disk_info.snapshot_link}
                                      labels:
                                        purpose: "restore-test"
                                        source-vm: ${vm.name}
                                        source-disk: ${disk_info.disk_name}
                                        managed-by: "workflow"
                                  result: disk_op

                              - wait_disk:
                                  call: googleapis.compute.v1.zoneOperations.wait
                                  args:
                                    project: ${project_id}
                                    zone: ${vm.zone}
                                    operation: ${disk_op.name}

                              - record_restored_disk:
                                  assign:
                                    - disk_record:
                                        name: ${disk_info.restored_name}
                                        boot: ${disk_info.is_boot}
                                        device_name: ${disk_info.device_name}
                                    - restored_disks: ${list.concat(restored_disks, disk_record)}

                    - log_all_disks_created:
                        call: sys.log
                        args:
                          text: '${"All " + string(len(restored_disks)) + " disks created for VM " + vm.name}'
                          severity: INFO

                    # Check we have the boot disk
                    - find_boot_disk:
                        assign:
                          - boot_disk_name: ""

                    - check_boot_exists:
                        for:
                          value: rd
                          in: ${restored_disks}
                          steps:
                            - check_if_boot:
                                switch:
                                  - condition: ${rd.boot}
                                    assign:
                                      - boot_disk_name: ${rd.name}

                    - validate_boot_disk:
                        switch:
                          - condition: ${boot_disk_name == ""}
                            steps:
                              - no_boot_disk:
                                  assign:
                                    - test_result:
                                        vm_name: ${vm.name}
                                        result: "FAIL"
                                        failure_reason: "No boot disk snapshot found"
                              - append_no_boot:
                                  assign:
                                    - results: ${list.concat(results, test_result)}
                              - notify_no_boot:
                                  call: notify_slack
                                  args:
                                    webhook_url: ${slack_webhook_url}
                                    vm_name: ${vm.name}
                                    project_id: ${project_id}
                                    environment: ${environment}
                                    app_type: ${vm.app_type}
                                    result: "FAIL"
                                    failure_reason: "No boot disk snapshot found"
                                    duration_seconds: 0
                                    snapshot_name: "N/A"
                                    evidence_url: "N/A"
                                    disks_count: 0
                              - skip_vm_no_boot:
                                  next: continue

                    # Build disk configuration for VM - Boot disk MUST be first
                    - build_disk_config:
                        assign:
                          - vm_disks: []
                          - data_disks: []

                    # First pass: separate boot disk from data disks
                    - separate_disks:
                        for:
                          value: rd
                          in: ${restored_disks}
                          steps:
                            - build_vm_disk_entry:
                                assign:
                                  - disk_source: ${"projects/" + project_id + "/zones/" + vm.zone + "/disks/" + rd.name}
                                  - vm_disk_entry:
                                      boot: ${rd.boot}
                                      autoDelete: true
                                      source: ${disk_source}
                                      deviceName: ${rd.device_name}

                            - classify_disk:
                                switch:
                                  - condition: ${rd.boot}
                                    assign:
                                      - vm_disks: ${list.concat(vm_disks, vm_disk_entry)}
                                  - condition: true
                                    assign:
                                      - data_disks: ${list.concat(data_disks, vm_disk_entry)}

                    # Second pass: append data disks after boot disk
                    - append_data_disks:
                        for:
                          value: dd
                          in: ${data_disks}
                          steps:
                            - add_data_disk:
                                assign:
                                  - vm_disks: ${list.concat(vm_disks, dd)}

                    - log_vm_disk_config:
                        call: sys.log
                        args:
                          text: '${"VM disk config: " + json.encode_to_string(vm_disks)}'
                          severity: INFO

                    # Create temp VM with all disks
                    - create_temp_vm:
                        call: googleapis.compute.v1.instances.insert
                        args:
                          project: ${project_id}
                          zone: ${vm.zone}
                          body:
                            name: ${"restore-test-" + vm.name + "-" + date_suffix}
                            machineType: ${"zones/" + vm.zone + "/machineTypes/" + vm.machine_type}
                            labels:
                              purpose: "restore-test"
                              source-vm: ${vm.name}
                              managed-by: "workflow"
                            tags:
                              items:
                                - ${vm.network_tag}
                            disks: ${vm_disks}
                            networkInterfaces:
                              - network: ${network}
                                subnetwork: ${subnet}
                            metadata:
                              items:
                                - key: "enable-oslogin"
                                  value: "false"
                        result: vm_op

                    - wait_vm_created:
                        call: googleapis.compute.v1.zoneOperations.wait
                        args:
                          project: ${project_id}
                          zone: ${vm.zone}
                          operation: ${vm_op.name}
                        result: vm_op_result

                    # Initial wait for VM to boot (60 seconds)
                    - initial_boot_wait:
                        call: sys.sleep
                        args:
                          seconds: 60

                    - get_vm_info:
                        call: googleapis.compute.v1.instances.get
                        args:
                          project: ${project_id}
                          zone: ${vm.zone}
                          instance: ${"restore-test-" + vm.name + "-" + date_suffix}
                        result: vm_info

                    - set_vm_ip:
                        assign:
                          - vm_internal_ip: ${vm_info.networkInterfaces[0].networkIP}

                    # Determine max retries based on app_type
                    # web/windows: 10 retries (up to 6 min total)
                    # databases: 4 retries (up to 3 min total)
                    - set_polling_config:
                        switch:
                          - condition: ${vm.app_type == "web" or vm.app_type == "windows"}
                            assign:
                              - max_retries: 10
                          - condition: true
                            assign:
                              - max_retries: 4

                    - init_polling:
                        assign:
                          - retry_count: 0
                          - validation_response: null
                          - polling_success: false

                    - log_polling_start:
                        call: sys.log
                        args:
                          text: '${"Starting validation polling for " + vm.name + " (max " + string(max_retries) + " retries)"}'
                          severity: INFO

                    # Polling loop - retry until service responds or max retries
                    - polling_loop:
                        for:
                          value: attempt
                          range: ${[1, max_retries + 1]}
                          steps:
                            - check_already_done:
                                switch:
                                  - condition: ${polling_success}
                                    next: continue

                            - log_attempt:
                                call: sys.log
                                args:
                                  text: '${"Validation attempt " + string(attempt) + "/" + string(max_retries) + " for " + vm.name}'
                                  severity: INFO

                            - try_validate:
                                try:
                                  steps:
                                    - call_validator:
                                        call: http.post
                                        args:
                                          url: ${validator_url}
                                          auth:
                                            type: OIDC
                                          body:
                                            vm_name: ${vm.name}
                                            vm_ip: ${vm_internal_ip}
                                            project_id: ${project_id}
                                            zone: ${vm.zone}
                                            app_type: ${vm.app_type}
                                            validation_port: ${vm.validation_port}
                                          timeout: 30
                                        result: validation_response

                                    - log_validation_done:
                                        call: sys.log
                                        args:
                                          text: '${"Validation responded for " + vm.name + ": success=" + string(validation_response.body.success) + ", details=" + validation_response.body.details}'
                                          severity: INFO

                                    # Only mark as success if validation actually passed
                                    - check_validation_success:
                                        switch:
                                          - condition: ${validation_response.body.success == true}
                                            assign:
                                              - polling_success: true
                                          - condition: true
                                            steps:
                                              - log_validation_failed:
                                                  call: sys.log
                                                  args:
                                                    text: '${"Validation returned false for " + vm.name + ", will retry..."}'
                                                    severity: INFO
                                              - wait_after_failed_validation:
                                                  switch:
                                                    - condition: ${attempt < max_retries}
                                                      steps:
                                                        - sleep_30_failed:
                                                            call: sys.sleep
                                                            args:
                                                              seconds: 30

                                except:
                                  as: poll_error
                                  steps:
                                    - log_poll_retry:
                                        call: sys.log
                                        args:
                                          text: '${"Validation attempt " + string(attempt) + " error for " + vm.name + ": " + poll_error.message + ", retrying in 30s..."}'
                                          severity: INFO

                                    - increment_retry:
                                        assign:
                                          - retry_count: ${attempt}

                                    - wait_before_retry:
                                        switch:
                                          - condition: ${attempt < max_retries}
                                            steps:
                                              - sleep_30:
                                                  call: sys.sleep
                                                  args:
                                                    seconds: 30

                    # Check if polling succeeded
                    - check_polling_result:
                        switch:
                          - condition: ${not polling_success}
                            steps:
                              - log_polling_failed:
                                  call: sys.log
                                  args:
                                    text: '${"Validation polling exhausted for " + vm.name + " after " + string(max_retries) + " attempts"}'
                                    severity: ERROR
                              - set_timeout_response:
                                  assign:
                                    - validation_response:
                                        body:
                                          success: false
                                          response_time_ms: 0
                                          details: ${"Service did not respond after " + string(max_retries) + " polling attempts"}

                    - record_end_time:
                        assign:
                          - end_time: ${sys.now()}
                          - duration_seconds: ${int(end_time) - int(start_time)}

                    # Build snapshot summary for evidence
                    - init_snapshot_summary:
                        assign:
                          - snapshot_summary: ""

                    - build_snapshot_summary:
                        for:
                          value: snap_name
                          in: ${all_snapshots_used}
                          steps:
                            - append_snap:
                                assign:
                                  - snapshot_summary: ${if(snapshot_summary == "", snap_name, snapshot_summary + ", " + snap_name)}

                    - build_evidence:
                        assign:
                          - evidence_path: ${"restore-tests/" + text.substring(date_suffix, 0, 4) + "/" + text.substring(date_suffix, 5, 7) + "/restore-test-" + date_suffix + "-" + vm.name + ".json"}
                          - evidence:
                              test_id: ${"restore-test-" + date_suffix + "-" + vm.name}
                              timestamp_start: ${text.substring(time.format(start_time), 0, 19) + "Z"}
                              timestamp_end: ${text.substring(time.format(end_time), 0, 19) + "Z"}
                              environment: ${environment}
                              project: ${project_id}
                              vm_name: ${vm.name}
                              app_type: ${vm.app_type}
                              disks_restored: ${len(restored_disks)}
                              snapshots_used: ${all_snapshots_used}
                              missing_snapshots: ${missing_snapshots}
                              temp_vm_name: ${"restore-test-" + vm.name + "-" + date_suffix}
                              metrics:
                                total_duration_seconds: ${duration_seconds}
                                validation_success: ${validation_response.body.success}
                                validation_response_ms: ${validation_response.body.response_time_ms}
                              validation:
                                vm_started: true
                                app_responsive: ${validation_response.body.success}
                                validation_result: ${if(validation_response.body.success, "PASS", "FAIL")}
                                validation_details: ${validation_response.body.details}
                              result: ${if(validation_response.body.success, "PASS", "FAIL")}
                              cleanup:
                                vm_deleted: true
                                disks_deleted: true

                    - save_evidence:
                        call: http.post
                        args:
                          url: ${"https://storage.googleapis.com/upload/storage/v1/b/" + bucket + "/o?uploadType=media&name=" + evidence_path}
                          headers:
                            Content-Type: "application/json"
                          auth:
                            type: OAuth2
                          body: ${evidence}

                    - set_evidence_url:
                        assign:
                          - evidence_url: ${"https://storage.cloud.google.com/" + bucket + "/" + evidence_path}

                    - notify_success:
                        call: notify_slack
                        args:
                          webhook_url: ${slack_webhook_url}
                          vm_name: ${vm.name}
                          project_id: ${project_id}
                          environment: ${environment}
                          app_type: ${vm.app_type}
                          result: ${if(validation_response.body.success, "PASS", "FAIL")}
                          failure_reason: ${if(validation_response.body.success, "", validation_response.body.details)}
                          duration_seconds: ${duration_seconds}
                          snapshot_name: ${snapshot_summary}
                          evidence_url: ${evidence_url}
                          disks_count: ${len(restored_disks)}

                    - build_result:
                        assign:
                          - test_result:
                              vm_name: ${vm.name}
                              result: ${if(validation_response.body.success, "PASS", "FAIL")}
                              duration_seconds: ${duration_seconds}
                              disks_restored: ${len(restored_disks)}
                          - results: ${list.concat(results, test_result)}

                except:
                  as: e
                  steps:
                    - log_error:
                        call: sys.log
                        args:
                          text: '${"Error testing VM " + vm.name + ": " + json.encode_to_string(e)}'
                          severity: ERROR

                    - notify_error:
                        call: notify_slack
                        args:
                          webhook_url: ${slack_webhook_url}
                          vm_name: ${vm.name}
                          project_id: ${project_id}
                          environment: ${environment}
                          app_type: ${vm.app_type}
                          result: "FAIL"
                          failure_reason: ${e.message}
                          duration_seconds: 0
                          snapshot_name: "N/A"
                          evidence_url: "N/A"
                          disks_count: 0

                    - append_error_result:
                        assign:
                          - test_result:
                              vm_name: ${vm.name}
                              result: "FAIL"
                              failure_reason: ${e.message}
                          - results: ${list.concat(results, test_result)}

            - cleanup_vm:
                try:
                  steps:
                    - delete_temp_vm:
                        call: googleapis.compute.v1.instances.delete
                        args:
                          project: ${project_id}
                          zone: ${vm.zone}
                          instance: ${"restore-test-" + vm.name + "-" + date_suffix}
                    - wait_vm_deleted:
                        call: sys.sleep
                        args:
                          seconds: 60
                    # Cleanup any orphaned disks (in case VM deletion didn't clean them)
                    - cleanup_disks:
                        for:
                          value: rd
                          in: ${restored_disks}
                          steps:
                            - try_delete_disk:
                                try:
                                  steps:
                                    - delete_disk:
                                        call: googleapis.compute.v1.disks.delete
                                        args:
                                          project: ${project_id}
                                          zone: ${vm.zone}
                                          disk: ${rd.name}
                                except:
                                  as: disk_err
                                  steps:
                                    - log_disk_cleanup:
                                        call: sys.log
                                        args:
                                          text: '${"Disk cleanup note for " + rd.name + ": " + disk_err.message}'
                                          severity: INFO
                except:
                  as: cleanup_error
                  steps:
                    - log_cleanup_error:
                        call: sys.log
                        args:
                          text: '${"Cleanup warning for VM " + vm.name + ": " + json.encode_to_string(cleanup_error)}'
                          severity: WARNING

    - return_results:
        return: ${results}

notify_slack:
  params:
    - webhook_url
    - vm_name
    - project_id
    - environment
    - app_type
    - result
    - failure_reason
    - duration_seconds
    - snapshot_name
    - evidence_url
    - disks_count
  steps:
    - build_message:
        switch:
          - condition: ${result == "PASS"}
            assign:
              - emoji: "✅"
              - status_text: "RESTAURACION EXITOSA"
              - color: "#36a64f"
          - condition: true
            assign:
              - emoji: "❌"
              - status_text: "RESTAURACION FALLIDA"
              - color: "#ff0000"

    - calculate_duration:
        assign:
          - minutes: ${int(duration_seconds / 60)}
          - seconds: ${duration_seconds - minutes * 60}
          - duration_text: ${string(minutes) + "m " + string(seconds) + "s"}
          - disks_text: ${string(disks_count) + " disco(s)"}

    - send_notification:
        call: http.post
        args:
          url: ${webhook_url}
          headers:
            Content-Type: "application/json"
          body:
            attachments:
              - color: ${color}
                blocks:
                  - type: "header"
                    text:
                      type: "plain_text"
                      text: ${emoji + " " + status_text}
                  - type: "section"
                    fields:
                      - type: "mrkdwn"
                        text: '${"*VM:*\n" + vm_name}'
                      - type: "mrkdwn"
                        text: '${"*Proyecto:*\n" + project_id}'
                      - type: "mrkdwn"
                        text: '${"*Ambiente:*\n" + environment}'
                      - type: "mrkdwn"
                        text: '${"*Tipo:*\n" + app_type}'
                      - type: "mrkdwn"
                        text: '${"*Snapshots:*\n" + snapshot_name}'
                      - type: "mrkdwn"
                        text: '${"*Tiempo total:*\n" + duration_text}'
                      - type: "mrkdwn"
                        text: '${"*Discos restaurados:*\n" + disks_text}'
                  - type: "section"
                    text:
                      type: "mrkdwn"
                      text: '${if(result == "PASS", ":white_check_mark: Validacion exitosa", ":x: *Error:* " + failure_reason)}'
                  - type: "section"
                    text:
                      type: "mrkdwn"
                      text: '${"<" + evidence_url + "|Ver evidencia completa>"}'

10	def get_secret(project_id: str, secret_id: str) -> str:

18	    start = time.time()

20	        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
21	        sock.settimeout(timeout)
22	        sock.connect((ip, port))
23	        sock.close()
24	        elapsed = int((time.time() - start) * 1000)
25	        return {"success": True, "response_time_ms": elapsed, "details": f"TCP port {port} open"}
26	    except Exception as e:

165	    vm_ip = body.get("vm_ip", "")

169	
170	    if not vm_ip:
171	        return jsonify({"success": False, "response_time_ms": 0, "details": "No VM IP provided"}), 400
172	
173	    validator = VALIDATORS.get(app_type)
174	    if not validator:
175	        return jsonify({"success": False, "response_time_ms": 0, "details": f"Unknown app_type: {app_type}"}), 400
176
